title: tec servicos offshore iii
description:
Job Purpose


Responsible for planning, executing, and coordinating activities related to the operations/installation of equipment produced by TechnipFMC for national and international clients. This includes participating in the development of operational installation procedures, in collaboration with the team, to ensure that operations/installations are carried out in accordance with operational procedures, safety standards, and client requirements.

Job Description


· Participate in briefing meetings with the coordination team regarding the planning of the operation to be carried out, in order to understand the procedures, resources, guidelines, and clarify any doubts.

· Contribute to the creation of databases for field occurrences and deviations by providing information to the integrated SAP system (S1), suggesting actions and measures to eliminate anomalies.

· Review documentation from previous operations through reports and study the procedures related to the upcoming operation, in order to be prepared to perform the assigned activities.

· Participate in the development of operational procedures (OP) for the client Petrobras, detailing the specific steps of the operation to be carried out, aiming to obtain STO validation (client support), which will be shared with other stakeholders.

· Receive, inspect, and verify the equipment mobilized and demobilized from offshore operations by checking the material lists, to ensure the system is intact and complies with all technical specifications, submitting this control to the client when requested.

· Perform equipment assembly and testing based on TechnipFMC and client procedures, using the necessary resources to initiate operations.

· Operate equipment according to operational procedures and safety standards, aiming to meet the demands of TechnipFMC and its clients.

· Prepare weekly activity reports on SharePoint, detailing the tasks performed each day, in accordance with the established deadlines and content requirements, to ensure the provision of information for time-off tracking, additional payments, and departmental cost control.

You are meant for this job if:



• Mechanical Technician Diploma;


• Active CFT registration; 


• Fluent English;


• Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);

Offshore experience in well completion and intervention, leadership position for hardware scope.
Proven experience in installation/intervention (workover) of subsea equipment using EDP, LRP, UEH, and HPU (SCVS/DPR):

  • Tubing Head (THD)
  • Tubing Hanger (TH)
  • Subsea Christmas Tree (ANM)
  • Tie-in, UTH, and SDH, among others.

Base: Rio de Janeiro / Offshore

title: Service Coordinator
description:
About Us
At Consilium Safety, we don't just create technology—we deliver solutions that protect people, assets, and the planet. As a global leader in fire and gas safety, we serve critical industries including marine, energy, rail, and construction. With over 100 years of expertise and 55 offices worldwide, we combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge innovation to shape the future of SafetyTech.

Job Summary
We are looking for a Service Coordinator based in Rio de Janeiro. The Service Coordinator is responsible for planning, organizing, and monitoring service activities, including customer support cases, warranty matters, and Annual Performance Tests (APT). You will ensure that all service operations run efficiently and consistently, maintaining the highest standards of customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to customer inquiries within 24 hours.
  • Plan and schedule service engineer attendances in line with the Consilium After Sales handbook and customer requirements.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate quotations for service activities.
  • Collect, store, and manage all service-related documentation in Consilium CRM and local servers.
  • Review service documentation and generate final customer invoices within seven days of completion.
  • Ensure necessary spare parts are prepared, allocated, and delivered for service attendances.
  • Maintain CRM records and adhere to company processes for service cases, NCRs, FAQs, and other mandated procedures.
  • Assist in training colleagues and external customers as required.
  • Promote safety awareness, contributing to accident prevention and maintaining a clean, organized workspace.
  • Conduct physical inventory counts as needed.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Preferred Education & Experience

  • High school diploma required; relevant degree or certification preferred.
  • Proficient in English (written and verbal).
  • Well-organized, quick learner, and able to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Strong decision-making skills in a fast-paced technical environment, with a focus on customer satisfaction.

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for career growth within a dynamic, expanding organization.
  • A diverse and inclusive culture that values teamwork and creativity.
  • Make a meaningful impact on the safety of industries worldwide.

Apply Now
If you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow, apply today and help us shape the future of SafetyTech.
